vi_sao: Bo eval viet tay, TRUOC khi viet code trich xuat. ADR-0004 co nam sua doi hop dong, ca nam do viec tinh golden vector bang tay loi ra. Doc chat tieng Viet noi chuyen phiem kho hon nhieu so voi doc mot cau nguoi ta co y viet cho bot, nen cho mo ho o day se nhieu hon chu khong it hon.
nguyen_tac: Voi tien, doan bay la te hon hoi. Ca nao khong du chac chan thi ky vong dung la must_ask, khong phai mot con so.
Moi khoan chi trich ra phai tro ve tin nhan nguon. Khong co trich dan thi nguoi duyet chi co the bam dong y.
Model chi trich xuat. Allocator tinh. Khong ca nao trong bo nay kiem tra phep chia.
